# ==========================================================================

# 22 currencies: G10 + EM
#
# Proxies:
#   Carry/Vol (x-axis): (Local rate - US FedFunds) / 60d annualized vol
#   Growth (y-axis): GDP YoY % (OECD quarterly, ffilled)
#   BMO uses proprietary MAPS growth factor — GDP YoY is best single proxy
# ==========================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# --- US Fed Funds (carry baseline) ---
us_fr_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
us_rate = ffill(us_fr_src.result)

# --- US GDP (for USD point) ---
us_gr_src = economic_indicators(series_id='A191RL1Q225SBEA')()
us_gw = ffill(us_gr_src.result)
us_cv = us_rate - us_rate

# ==========================================================================
# G10 CURRENCIES
# ==========================================================================

# EUR (primary asset)
eur_vol = stddev(period=60)(returns(period=1)(src.c)) * 1587.45
e_rr_src = economic_indicators(series_id='ECBDFR')()
eur_cv = (ffill(e_rr_src.result) - us_rate) / eur_vol
e_gr_src = economic_indicators(series_id='NAEXKP01EZQ659S')()
eur_gw = ffill(e_gr_src.result)
